text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Whoops... didn't realize you were there.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Heh-heh, my bad. I got totally caught up 
in the zone――

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
All five senses are geared entirely toward 
competition. She's tuned up to a 
fascinatingly sharp degree...!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Now then, shall we get going...!
